arxiv-2101-10952.title: “Laughing at you or with you”: The Role of Sarcasm in Shaping the Disagreement Space
arxiv-2101-10952.creator: Debanjan Ghosh, Ritvik Shrivastava and Smaranda Muresan
arxiv-2101-10952.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Debanjan Ghosh, Ritvik Shrivastava and Smaranda Muresan. Detecting arguments in online interactions is useful to understand how conflicts arise and get resolved. Users often use figurative language, such as sarcasm, either as persuasive devices or to attack the opponent by an ad hominem argument. To further our understanding of the role of sarcasm in shaping the disagreement space, we present a thorough experimental setup using a corpus annotated with both argumentative moves (agree/disagree) and sarcasm.

arxiv-2205-13213.title: Fast Vision Transformers with HiLo Attention
arxiv-2205-13213.creator: Zizheng Pan, Jianfei Cai, Bohan Zhuang
arxiv-2205-13213.description: Abstract Vision Transformers (ViTs) have triggered the most recent and significant breakthroughs in computer vision. Their efficient designs are mostly guided by the indirect metric of computational complexity, i . e ., FLOPs, which however has a clear gap with the direct metric such as throughput.

arxiv-2209-00895.title: Optimistic Optimization of Gaussian Process Samples
arxiv-2209-00895.creator: Julia Grosse, Cheng Zhang, Philipp Hennig
arxiv-2209-00895.description: Abstract Bayesian optimization is a popular formalism for global optimization, but its computational costs limit it to expensive-to-evaluate functions. A competing, computationally more efficient, global optimization framework is optimistic optimization , which exploits prior knowledge about the geometry of the search space in form of a dissimilarity function.

arxiv-2210-14816.title: Deep Subspace Encoders for Nonlinear System Identification
arxiv-2210-14816.creator: Gerben I. Beintema ∗, Maarten Schoukens, Roland Toth
arxiv-2210-14816.description: Abstract Using Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) for nonlinear system identification has proven to be a promising approach, but despite of all recent research efforts, many practical and theoretical problems still remain open. Specifically, noise handling and models, issues of consistency and reliable estimation under minimisation of the prediction error are the most severe problems.

arxiv-2306-05410.title: LU-NeRF: Scene and Pose Estimation by Synchronizing Local Unposed NeRFs
arxiv-2306-05410.creator: Zezhou Cheng, Carlos Esteves, Varun Jampani, Abhishek Kar, Subhransu Maji, Ameesh Makadia
arxiv-2306-05410.description: Abstract A critical obstacle preventing NeRF models from being deployed broadly in the wild is their reliance on accurate camera poses. Consequently, there is growing interest in extending NeRF models to jointly optimize camera poses and scene representation, which offers an alternative to off-the-shelf SfM pipelines which have well-understood failure modes.

arxiv-2406-07248.title: Infinite-Horizon Distributionally Robust Regret-Optimal Control
arxiv-2406-07248.creator: Taylan Kargin, Joudi Hajar, Vikrant Malik, Babak Hassibi
arxiv-2406-07248.description: Abstract We study the infinite-horizon distributionally robust (DR) control of linear systems with quadratic costs, where disturbances have unknown, possibly time-correlated distribution within a Wasserstein-2 ambiguity set. We aim to minimize the worst-case expected regret—the excess cost of a causal policy compared to a non-causal one with access to future disturbance.

arxiv-2410-08921.title: Separating hypergraph Turán densities
arxiv-2410-08921.creator: Hong Liu, Bjarne Schülke, Shuaichao Wang, Haotian Yang, Yixiao Zhang
arxiv-2410-08921.description: Abstract . Determining the Turán densities of hypergraphs is a notoriously difficult problem at the core of combinatorics. Although Turán posed this problem in 1941, π ⁡ ( K ℓ ( k ) ) \pi(K_{\ell}^{(k)}) remains unknown for all ℓ > k ≥ 3 \ell>k\geq 3 .

arxiv-2503-20162.title: Beyond Worst-Case Subset Sum: An Adaptive, Structure-Aware Solver with Sub- 2 n / 2 2^{n/2} Enumeration
arxiv-2503-20162.creator: Jesus Salas
arxiv-2503-20162.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jesus Salas. The Subset Sum problem, which asks whether a given set of n n integers contains a subset summing to a specified target t t , is a fundamental NP-complete problem arising in cryptography, combinatorial optimization, and beyond. The classical meet-in-the-middle (MIM) algorithm of Horowitz and Sahni achieves a worst-case time complexity of O ∗ ​ ( 2 n / 2 ) O^{*}(2^{n/2}) , which remains the best-known deterministic bound.

arxiv-2506-19404.title: Loss functions incorporating auditory spatial perception in deep learning – a review
arxiv-2506-19404.creator: Boaz Rafaely, Stefan Weinzierl, Or Berebi, Fabian Brinkmann
arxiv-2506-19404.description: Abstract Binaural reproduction aims to deliver immersive spatial audio with high perceptual realism over headphones. Loss functions play a central role in optimizing and evaluating algorithms that generate binaural signals. However, traditional signal-related difference measures often fail to capture the perceptual properties that are essential to spatial audio quality.

arxiv-2507-13357.title: Adaptive Linguistic Prompting (ALP) Enhances Phishing Webpage Detection in Multimodal Large Language Models Thanks: Senior Author
arxiv-2507-13357.creator: Atharva Bhargude, Ishan Gonehal, Chandler Haney, Dave Yoon, Aaron Sandoval, Sean O’Brien, Kaustubh Vinnakota
arxiv-2507-13357.description: Abstract Phishing attacks represent a significant cybersecurity threat, necessitating adaptive detection techniques. This study explores few-shot Adaptive Linguistic Prompting (ALP) in detecting phishing webpages through the multimodal capabilities of state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-4o and Gemini 1.5 Pro.

arxiv-2512-01918.title: No Love for black holes: tightest constraints on tidal Love numbers of black holes from GW250114
arxiv-2512-01918.creator: M. Andrés-Carcasona, G. Caneva Santoro
arxiv-2512-01918.description: Abstract Tidal Love numbers of black holes, zero in classical general relativity for Kerr black holes in vacuum, become non-vanishing in the presence of exotic matter or in alternative theories of gravity, making them a powerful probe of fundamental physics. The gravitational-wave event GW250114, observed with an unprecedented signal-to-noise ratio, provides a unique opportunity to test this prediction.

europmc-pmc3102656.title: Choosing and using a plant DNA barcode.
europmc-pmc3102656.creator: Hollingsworth PM, Graham SW, Little DP.
europmc-pmc3102656.description: The main aim of DNA barcoding is to establish a shared community resource of DNA sequences that can be used for organismal identification and taxonomic clarification. This approach was successfully pioneered in animals using a portion of the cytochrome oxidase 1 (CO1)...

pmc-10739365.title: COGNITIVE TRAJECTORIES IN MIDDLE-AGED AMERICANS, 1995–2018
pmc-10739365.creator: Rebecca Brown, Xi Zuo, Corey McMillan, Shana Stites, Irma Elo, Kenneth Langa, Jason Karlawish, Dawei Xie
pmc-10739365.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Given evidence that Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD) develop over decades, middle age is increasingly recognized as a key life course period to target modifiable risk factors for cognitive decline and ADRD. Epidemiological trends show that the prevalence of chronic conditions that are risk factors for ADRD has increased in middle-aged adults over the past several decades, but it is unknown if cognitive trajectories have worsened in middle-aged people over this time period.

pmc-11336660.title: Data-driven biomarkers better associate with stroke motor outcomes than theory-based biomarkers
pmc-11336660.creator: Emily R Olafson, Christoph Sperber, Keith W Jamison, Mark D Bowren, Aaron D Boes, Justin W Andrushko, Michael R Borich, Lara A Boyd, Jessica M Cassidy, Adriana B Conforto, Steven C Cramer, Adrienne N Dula, Fatemeh Geranmayeh, Brenton Hordacre, Neda Jahanshad, Steven A Kautz, Bethany P Tavenner, Brad
pmc-11336660.description: Chronic motor impairments are a leading cause of disability after stroke. Previous studies have associated motor outcomes with the degree of damage to predefined structures in the motor system, such as the corticospinal tract. However, such theory-based approaches may not take full advantage of the information contained in clinical imaging data.

pmc-11433688.title: Sanger Sequencing Reveals Novel Variants in GLO-1, ACE, and CBR1 Genes in Patients of Early and Severe Diabetic Nephropathy
pmc-11433688.creator: Syed Zubair Hussain Shah, Amir Rashid, Asifa Majeed, Tariq Ghafoor, Nadeem Azam, Wisit Cheungpasitporn
pmc-11433688.description: Background and Objectives: Diabetes is a global health issue, with approximately 50% of patients developing diabetic nephropathy (DN) and 25% experiencing early and severe forms of the disease. The genetic factors contributing to rapid disease progression in a subset of these patients are unclear.

pmc-11673839.title: Repurposing Historic Drugs for Neutrophil-Mediated Inflammation in Skin Disorders
pmc-11673839.creator: Ludovica Franceschin, Alessia Guidotti, Roberto Mazzetto, Jacopo Tartaglia, Christian Ciolfi, Mauro Alaibac, Alvise Sernicola, Angelo Valerio Marzano, Sergio Crovella, Chiara Moltrasio
pmc-11673839.description: Neutrophil-mediated inflammation is a key feature of immune-mediated chronic skin disorders, but the mechanistic understanding of neutrophil involvement in these conditions remains incomplete. Dapsone, colchicine, and tetracyclines are established drugs within the dermatologist’s therapeutic armamentarium that are credited with potent anti-neutrophilic effects. Anti-neutrophilic drugs have established themselves as versatile agents in the treatment of a wide range of dermatological conditions.

pmc-12381140.title: Improved pulmonary embolism detection in CT pulmonary angiogram scans with hybrid vision transformers and deep learning techniques
pmc-12381140.creator: Abeer Abdelhamid, Amir El-Ghamry, Ehab H Abdelhay, Mohammed M Abo-Zahhad, Hossam El-Din Moustafa
pmc-12381140.description: Pulmonary embolism (PE) represents a severe, life-threatening cardiovascular condition and is notably the third leading cause of cardiovascular mortality, after myocardial infarction and stroke. This pathology occurs when blood clots obstruct the pulmonary arteries, impeding blood flow and oxygen exchange in the lungs. Prompt and accurate detection of PE is critical for appropriate clinical decision-making and patient survival.

pmc-12654857.title: Phenyllactic Acid as a Marker of Antibiotic-Induced Metabolic Activity of Nosocomial Strains of Klebsiella pneumoniae In Vitro Experiment
pmc-12654857.creator: Maria Getsina, Ekaterina Chernevskaya, Ekaterina Sorokina, Tatiana Chernenkaya, Natalia Beloborodova, Nico Jehmlich, Theodoros Varzakas, Ute Römling
pmc-12654857.description: Klebsiella pneumoniae (K. pneumoniae) is a major nosocomial pathogen with increasing antibiotic resistance. Treatment failures and high mortality rates in sepsis caused by K. pneumoniae are associated with difficulties in choosing an adequate antibacterial therapy in the presence of resistance to all available antibiotics, based on the results of susceptibility tests.

pmc-12750564.title: Genome-wide identification of heat shock factors in Myricaria laxiflora and their response to abiotic stresses
pmc-12750564.creator: Linbao Li, Bicheng Dun, Jiayi Gu, Wei Yin, Junchen Wang, Yang Su, Weibo Xiang, Di Wu
pmc-12750564.description: Myricaria laxiflora is a rare and endangered shrub in China, and its wild populations are threatened by diverse abiotic stresses. Heat shock factors (HSFs) are essential for coping with environmental stresses, however, information about HSFs in M. laxiflora is limited. Currently, a total of 21 MlHSFs were systematically detected in the latest released genome of M. laxiflora.

pmc-12755835.title: Core components of emotional impulsivity: A mouse-cursor tracking study
pmc-12755835.creator: Anton Leontyev, Takashi Yamauchi
pmc-12755835.description: Impulsive individuals exhibit abnormal reward processing (heightened preference for immediate rewards, i.e., impulsive choice, IC) and a penchant for maladaptive action (the inability to inhibit inappropriate actions, i.e., impulsive action, IA). Both impulsive choice and impulsive action are strongly influenced by emotions (emotional impulsivity); yet how emotions impact impulsive behavior remains unclear.

pmc-12955617.title: Identification of a conformational epitope on the E antigen implicated in anti-E alloimmunization
pmc-12955617.creator: Hideaki Matsuura, Ayuna Yamada, Hiroki Doi, Sumie Fujii, Yasuo Miura
pmc-12955617.description: cells1 together with additional processes involving antigen-presenting cells and B cells; however, not all exposed individuals develop such antibodies. Indeed, only 1.1% to 1.4% of pregnant women and 4.5% to 12.2% of patients who have received multiple transfusions develop alloantibodies,2, 3, 4, 5 suggesting genetic or immunological variability.

pmc-13011084.title: Reconstruction of extensive craniofacial defect following paraganglioma excision using a chimeric anterolateral thigh flap: a case report
pmc-13011084.creator: Phan Tuấn Nghĩa, Đặng Phương Nam, Trần Thiết Sơn
pmc-13011084.description: Extended radical excision of aggressive tumors, such as the carotid paraganglioma involving the ethmoid, maxillary and intracranial spaces, results in massive composite craniofacial defects. Successful reconstruction requires simultaneously achieving effective dead space refilling and creating a stable anophthalmic orbital socket. This report highlights the utility of the chimeric anterolateral thigh (ALT) flap in addressing this reconstructive challenge.

pmc-13196792.title: Contamination and antibiotic resistance profile of Cronobacter sakazakii isolated from raw milk and infant formula
pmc-13196792.creator: Zahra Taji, Mojtaba Bonyadian, Hamdallah Moshtaghi
pmc-13196792.description: Background and Objectives:Cronobacter sakazakii is an opportunistic pathogen associated with severe fatal infections. This study aimed to investigate the contamination of raw milk delivered to a powdered milk factory and the produced powdered milk, with C. sakazakii, and also the antibiotic resistance patterns of the isolates.

pmc-13388735.title: Upper-Limb asymmetry in wheelchair para-athletes: a comparative analysis across sports disciplines
pmc-13388735.creator: Marco Kokaly, Antonia Carvallo, Catalina Guzmán, María Jesús Prieto, Matías Henríquez, Oscar Valencia
pmc-13388735.description: BackgroundWheelchair use has increased globally, with many individuals relying on wheelchairs not only for mobility but also for participation in sport. However, upper-limb (UL) asymmetries are common among wheelchair athletes and may contribute to overuse injuries. Limited evidence exists regarding how asymmetry differs among athletes in para-sports who use wheelchairs to compete.
